title: Notification Preference Center & Frequency Caps
learningObjectives: Model granular category, channel, and frequency preference rules
Implement rate-limiting and deduplication frequency caps (anti-spam)
Honor regulatory unsubscribe mandates (CAN-SPAM, GDPR) via one-click signed tokens
keyTradeoffs: Opt-in default vs opt-out default for non-transactional messages
Evaluating preferences in worker queues vs filtering at the event producer
commonPitfalls: Sending marketing emails to users who explicitly unsubscribed, triggering legal penalties
Flooding a user with 50 duplicate push notifications when a single batch event fires
transferPrompt: How would you test and verify preference compliance in automated integration tests?
